# Image Sources

This directory contains static images used in the blog post. Always
document the source and license of each image.

## Status (2026-08-25)

All three ambiance slots are genuine Gemini generations as of
2026-08-25 (generated via the `gemini-image-generator` tool),
replacing generic stock-coffee-flatlay placeholders.

## Image slots in use

| Slot | File | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Ambiance 1 | `ambiance1.jpg` | DONE. A cluster of small potted plants of different species, each in an identical terracotta pot. Metaphor: several distinct books served identically from one shared infrastructure. |
| Ambiance 2 | `ambiance2.jpg` | DONE. A brass mail-sorting rack with several distinct labeled slots. Metaphor: one subdomain routing to each book. |
| Ambiance 3 | `ambiance3.jpg` | DONE. A wax letter seal being pressed into fresh red wax on an envelope. Metaphor: automatic SSL certification sealing every deploy. |

All three processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.

## hero.png

- **Source**: Generated with Google Gemini (2026-06-20) from a
  custom prompt depicting six jewel-toned textbooks feeding lines
  into a single domain hub and back out to six rendered web pages.
- **License**: AI-generated; no third-party rights asserted.
- **Dimensions**: 1376 x 768 (16:9).
- **Usage**: Hero image for the blog post listing and opening.
